title: Construction/upgrading/rehabilitation of Drainage along National Roads, Manila North Road, Capas, Tarlac
description: ASSET PRESERVATION PROGRAM: CONSTRUCTION/UPGRADING/REHABILITATION OF DRAINAGE ALONG NATIONAL ROADS - PRIMARY ROADS - MANILA NORTH ROAD, KO106+962 TO KO107+623, CAPAS, TARLAC
colour_meaning: Check: not scored, but a tested “looks fine on paper” pattern.

reasons.title: Price per km above 90% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱143.1M per km; the 90th percentile of similar works (Drainage along roads, 112 past contracts) is ₱97.0M per km. Length read from the title: 661 m.
reasons.evidence: A weaker version of the price sign.
checks: Check the stated length and the scope, as for the stronger price sign.

reasons.title: The winner's other projects drew citizen reports
reasons.detail: L.S.D.  CONSTRUCTION & SUPPLIES has 2 other DPWH projects reported by citizens (ghost/defective/unfinished tags)
reasons.evidence: A contractor whose other roads drew 2+ citizen reports had about 4.5 times the odds of a report.
checks: Open the winner's reported projects on the DPWH Transparency Portal and read what citizens reported.
Plan a site visit or ask a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, TAPAT) to look once work starts.
